headings.usage: Hero typography, section headers, product names. Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use italic weight for accents.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation links, buttons, admin dashboard.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) across the entire site to remove digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.bento_marketing: Use asymmetric layouts. Text on one side, overlapping large image on the other. Large negative space.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Tight grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Use solid borders (#2A201A) and zero border-radius (sharp edges) or max 4px for a highly premium, structural feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#0D0A08] hover:bg-[#E8D3A2] rounded-none px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#F4EFE6] border border-[#F4EFE6]/20 hover:border-[#D4AF37] hover:text-[#D4AF37] rounded-none px-8 py-4 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase transition-all duration-300
buttons.magnetic: Wrap primary buttons in Framer Motion magnetic hover effect.

cards.marketing: Cardless design. Large unconstrained imagery with overlapping text. No generic boxes.
cards.admin: Sharp rectangular cards (rounded-none), bg-[#140F0C], border border-[#2A201A], p-6.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism sticky header. Transparent at top, blurs on scroll. Logo centered or left.
navigation.links: Hover state: underline animation or color change to gold.

forms.inputs: bg-transparent border-b border-[#F4EFE6]/20 rounded-none focus:border-[#D4AF37] text-[#F4EFE6] px-0 py-3 ring-0 outline-none transition-colors

motion_and_3d.scroll: MUST use Lenis for smooth scrolling.
motion_and_3d.parallax: Use Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform for subtle image parallax inside overflow-hidden containers.
motion_and_3d.reveal: Staggered text reveal for H1 and section headers (words moving up from a mask).

3d_libraries.hero: @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei for floating coffee beans and subtle steam particles.
3d_libraries.alternatives: If 3D is too heavy, use Framer Motion 3D or high-quality video/image sequence.

motion_and_3d.micro_interactions: Custom cursor (a small gold dot, expands on hover). Image hover: slight scale (1.05) and darken overlay.

media_and_images.style: Cinematic, dark, high contrast, warm lighting. Deep browns and blacks.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient gradient overlay (e.g., from-black/80 to-transparent).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for 3D and heavy scroll effects.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='explore-menu-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react, framer-motion, @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, lenis for frontend.
Set up Tailwind config with provided colors, fonts, and custom utilities (e.g., grain overlay).
Use Manrope for body font and Cormorant Garamond for headings. Import them via Google Fonts in index.html.
Build the marketing page with pure HTML/Tailwind and Framer Motion. Do not use standard Shadcn cards for marketing sections.
For the Admin dashboard and Menus, use customized Shadcn components (sharp corners, dark theme colors).
Implement a custom cursor that reacts to hoverable elements.
Never use generic placeholders. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure the hero section has high visual impact, combining the dark cafe interior or espresso pouring image with overlapping bold serif text.
You MUST write code in .js / .jsx files only, NOT .tsx files. Ignore Shadcn .tsx defaults, convert them to .jsx.

universal_guidelines.no_generic_slop: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids or overlapping editorial layouts.
universal_guidelines.depth: Create depth with layered elements, subtle shadows, and parallax scrolling.
universal_guidelines.animations: Every interaction needs micro-animations. Static is dead.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use 2x-3x more spacing (py-24 or py-32 for sections) than typical apps.
universal_guidelines.components: Use sonner for toasts. Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays. Always provide backdrop blurs.
